# obix-runtime-dom

> Previous name: `@obinexusltd/obix-runtime-dom` — OBIX packages are named without an npm scope since decision D-102 (2026-09-29); the package, its version and its exports are unchanged.

The DOM of OBIX's native runtime: the rules by which a value of the canonical IR becomes an attribute and becomes text, and the host operations the runtime builds and updates a page with — HTML's rules, no framework's. Phase 6 (docs/recovery/native-runtime.md).

<!-- obix-release:begin — generated by scripts/release/prepare.mjs; edit the text above this line -->

## Installation

```bash
npm install obix-runtime-dom
```

> **Not yet on npm.** The OBIX packages are prepared for publication and are published only on the owner's authorisation; until then this is the command the published package will answer to.

## Basic usage

```js
import { BOOLEAN_ATTRIBUTES, NAMESPACE_URI, ObixRuntimeError, attributeText } from 'obix-runtime-dom';
```

## API surface

- `obix-runtime-dom` — 11 value exports: `BOOLEAN_ATTRIBUTES`, `NAMESPACE_URI`, `ObixRuntimeError`, `attributeText`, `contentNamespace`, `createElementIn`, `displayText`, `elementNamespace`, `namespaceInside`, `setAttributeValue`, `setBoundAttribute`
- Type declarations: `./dist/index.d.ts` (and a declaration next to every JS entry point).

## Architecture role

`obix-runtime-dom` is part of the **experimental native browser runtime** (Phase 6): it runs canonical DOP IR with no Vue. Applications that choose the native runtime install `obix-runtime-browser`; the other runtime packages are its lower layers.

The architecture of OBIX — the package families and which packages are public API — is indexed in the umbrella: [docs/architecture.md](https://github.com/obinexus/obix/blob/main/docs/architecture.md).

## Package relationships

- Depends on (OBIX): [`obix-runtime-reactivity`](https://github.com/obinexus/obix-runtime-reactivity).
- Used by (OBIX): [`obix-runtime-browser`](https://github.com/obinexus/obix-runtime-browser), [`obix-runtime-component`](https://github.com/obinexus/obix-runtime-component).

## Testing

- 2 test files ship in the npm package (`test/`): they are the evidence of the package's contract, published so that its verification can be read — not runtime code (no entry point reaches them).
- Run them with `npm test` (`node --test "test/*.test.mjs"`) in the OBIX monorepo, which provides the test tooling (Node's test runner, TypeScript).
